description: Use this when someone asks how long the oil in their tank will last, when they need to order, or how much to order. Takes the tank size, how full it is and rough daily use, and returns litres in the tank, cautious days remaining, a suggested top-up and how soon to act. An estimate from typical usage, not a measurement. Runs for any oil tank and needs no location.

tankCapacityLitres.description: Tank size in litres. Many Irish domestic tanks hold about 1,000 to 1,350 litres.

tankLevelPercent.description: How full the tank is now, as a percentage.

usage.description: Daily oil use: lower is about 8 litres, typical about 14, higher about 20.

name: tankful_tank_plan
title: How long will my heating oil last
